text_markup: If at any time a player's score is greater than or equal to 7, they win the game at the next checkpoint. See {ref:sec_ending_the_game} regarding winning the game, and {ref:sec_checkpoints} for details about checkpoints.
text_plain: If at any time a player's score is greater than or equal to 7, they win the game at the next checkpoint. See section 1.7 regarding winning the game, and section 10.3 for details about checkpoints.
